description.zh: 要查询的EIP绑定的辅助弹性网卡的ID。
description.en: The ID of the secondary ENI that is associated with the EIP.

description.zh: 要查询的EIP所属的地域。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en: The region to which the EIP that you want to query belongs. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 查询EIP的网关和掩码信息

descriptions.zh: 仅支持查询以多EIP网卡可见模式绑定辅助弹性网卡的EIP的网关和掩码信息。
descriptions.en: You can query only EIPs that are associated with secondary elastic network interfaces (ENIs) in multi-EIP-to-ENI mode.
